rationale.consistency: Mirrors CookieFilter closely (struct, Validate, module ID, labelled loop, interface assertions); extra []string branch departs from how sibling filters handle arrays.
rationale.edge_cases: Unparseable lines pass through, exact name match, quoting preserved, delete drops the whole value, suffix kept verbatim via Cut; leading whitespace before name is silently dropped on rewrite.
rationale.scope: Delivers the feature, but adds speculative []string handling and an unrelated Validator assertion for CookieFilter.
rationale.readability: Clear names and flow; LINES label matches existing OUTER style; struct doc is terse but adequate.
rationale.robustness: No panics: type switch guards Interface, ParseSetCookie errors handled, unknown types returned unchanged.
rationale.maintainability: UnmarshalCaddyfile is a near-verbatim copy of CookieFilter's with no shared helper; otherwise straightforward to extend.
